body:
The sun was setting behind the buildings, casting long shadows across the street. I noticed a group of men gathered around the crate, their hands reaching for it as if in awe or fear. Their eyes darted nervously between me and the crate, each one looking slightly different from the last—some cautious, others hesitant.

I felt my heart race but also a surge of purpose. This wasn't just any crate; it had been left behind by the previous tenant who had vanished without a trace. The weight of responsibility fell upon me suddenly—it seemed almost too much to bear.

Their eyes darted nervously between me and the crate, each one looking slightly different from the last—some cautious, others hesitant.

I felt my heart race but also a surge of purpose. This wasn't just any crate; it had been left behind by the previous tenant who had vanished without a trace. The weight of responsibility fell upon me suddenly—it seemed almost too much to bear.

Next: stay beside them and keep them steady.
